title: Warehouse Escape
constraints: 1 ≤ r, c ≤ 500; the grid contains exactly one S and one E
hints: Every move costs the same. Which traversal finds shortest paths in unweighted graphs?
Process cells in a queue in order of distance; mark a cell visited when you push it, not when you pop it.
Recursive DFS can exceed the stack on a 500×500 serpentine maze, and it does not give shortest paths anyway.
